Free groups

Source: R/combinatorics-fpgroups.R
FreeGroup.Rd

FreeGroup(symbols) is the free group on the given symbols; groups on the same symbols are the same object, as in SymPy. free_group(symbols) returns a list whose first element is the group and whose remaining elements are its generators. symbols is a string such as "x, y" or "x:3", a character vector or a list of Symbols. Words multiply with *, are raised to integer powers with ^ and divided with /; < compares them in the length lexicographic order of SymPy. fp_order(), fp_is_abelian(), fp_center(), fp_elements() and fp_contains() work on free groups too, and fg_slice() is SymPy's F[i:j].

Usage

FreeGroup(symbols)

free_group(symbols)

xfree_group(symbols)

fg_slice(G, from = 0L, to = G$rank)

fg_index(G, gen)

fp_contains(G, gen)

Arguments

symbols

The generator names.

G

A free group.

from, to

Zero based slice limits, as in Python.

gen

A generator of G.

Value

A FreeGroup (an environment), a list, or an integer.

Examples

G <- free_group("x, y, z")
F <- G[[1]]; x <- G[[2]]; y <- G[[3]]
fp_str(F)
#> [1] "<free group on the generators (x, y, z)>"
fp_str(x^2 * y * x^-1 * x)
#> [1] "x^2*y"
fp_str(fg_slice(F, 1))
#> [1] "<free group on the generators (y, z)>"
